# PRLog

> > PRLog is a free press release distribution service connecting businesses, experts, and journalists through news distribution, expert directories, and media outreach tools.

PRLog provides free press release distribution with SEO benefits, RSS feeds, and email alerts for journalists and bloggers. The platform includes expert directories across various industries and locations, press room hosting, and comprehensive news archives organized by date, location, and category.

## Key Topics

- Press release distribution
- News distribution services
- Expert directories
- Journalist outreach
- Media distribution
- RSS feeds and alerts
- Free PR service
- Search engine optimization (SEO)
- Press room hosting
- United States news
- International coverage (UAE, Australia)
- Professional bios and profiles
- Industry expertise matching
- News archives
- Content syndication

## Core Services

- [Free Press Release Distribution Service - PRLog](https://www.prlog.org/): Homepage for PRLog's free press release distribution service
- [Submit Press Release](https://www.prlog.org/pub/): Press release submission and publishing interface
- [Latest News (Press Releases)](https://www.prlog.org/news/): Latest press releases and news feed listings
- [United States - Press Release News](https://www.prlog.org/news/us/): US-filtered press releases with state and industry filters

## Journalist & Media Resources

- [For Journalists and Bloggers](https://www.prlog.org/journalist.html): Journalist tools: RSS feeds, email alerts, and query posting

## Expert Directories

- [Memory Loss Experts in United States](https://bio.prlog.org/us/memory-loss/): US memory loss expert directory featuring Cathleen Spacil
- [Life Skills Experts in United States](https://bio.prlog.org/us/life-skills/): US life skills expert directory featuring ARISE Foundation
